Each scenario category on the x-axis contains three distinct bars, one for each year (2030, 2040, 2050), not a single bar.

The color for 'Природен Газ' (Natural Gas) is dark yellow/ochre, not orange-red. This could be confused with 'Ядрена' (Nuclear), which is orange.
